full_name: Jorge Ignacio Cortiñas | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2021–2022 Arts Perrin Moorhead Grayson and Bruns Grayson Fellow Independent Artist
bio: Jorge Ignacio Cortiñas is a theater maker and the artistic director of the Obie-winning company Fulcrum Theater. His theater work considers how history writes itself into the present through the limited choices that hem in, and simultaneously create possibility in, the lives of his characters. His most recent play, Recent Alien Abductions, examines asymmetrical power relationships at the geopolitical level (between Puerto Rico and the United States) and the interpersonal level (between a queer child and a straight family). That play premiered at the Humana Festival at the Actors Theater of Louisville under the direction of Les Waters.
